title: langgraph-checkpoint-postgres==3.1.2
summary: Changes since checkpointpostgres==3.1.1 release(checkpoint-postgres): 3.1.2 ( #8565 ) release(checkpoint): 4.2.0 ( #8563 ) test(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): run the conformance suite ( #8537 ) fix(checkpoint-postgres): find plain-value seeds when walking delta history ( #8535 ) chore: enable RUF100 and clear unused noqa directives ( #8546 ) chore(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): enable PLC0415 lint
body:
Changes since checkpointpostgres==3.1.1

- release(checkpoint-postgres): 3.1.2 ( #8565 )

- release(checkpoint): 4.2.0 ( #8563 )

- test(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): run the conformance suite ( #8537 )

- fix(checkpoint-postgres): find plain-value seeds when walking delta history ( #8535 )

- chore: enable RUF100 and clear unused noqa directives ( #8546 )

- chore(checkpoint-postgres,checkpoint-sqlite): enable PLC0415 lint rule ( #8540 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/checkpoint-postgres with 5 updates ( #8497 )
summaryZh: LangGraph 发布了 checkpoint-postgres 3.1.2 版本更新。此次更新主要修复了在处理 delta 历史记录时查找 plain-value seeds 的问题，并引入了 conformance suite 测试以增强兼容性。此外，通过启用 RUF100 和 PLC0415 等 lint 规则，提升了代码库的质量与可维护性。该版本进一步优化了 Agent 状态持久化机制，对于依赖 Postgres 进行状态管理的复杂 Agent 系统具有重要的工程意义。

aiReview.reasonZh: LangGraph作为主流Agent开发框架，其检查点存储功能的更新对Agent状态持久化至关重要。
